name: novago-apps
description: Nova Go — one codebase, four apps (customer / driver / merchant / ops).

scripts.cap:sync:customer: npm run app:customer && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:driver: npm run app:driver && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:merchant: npm run app:merchant && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:ops: npm run app:ops && npx cap sync
scripts.vendor:socket: mkdir -p vendor && curl -fL -o vendor/socket.io.min.js https://cdn.socket.io/4.7.5/socket.io.min.js && echo 'vendored -> vendor/socket.io.min.js'
